title: Human Influence Telemetry
description: An open documentary assurance method for evaluating whether human authority retained practical force in AI-mediated institutional decisions. Version 0.6.7 collects partial Ofqual author adjudication, a preserved Jev advisory run, three further qualitative reanalyses, a working methods/resource manuscript, three source-bound exhibits, and a frozen synthetic evidence-update rehearsal. Both assistant responses to equivalent graph and table packets identified four injected changes; no comparative advantage was demonstrated. Counsel, the documentary comparison and new manuscript claims remain unresolved or pending responsible-author review. It preserves normative contract 0.4.0, conformance engine 0.5.0, the bounded 0.6.0 human result, and Level 2 research maturity. Publication does not establish current-contract replication, independent implementability, comparative usefulness or satisfaction of any v1 stable-release gate. The v0.6.5 claim-evidence audit retains its historical scope. The manuscript is a working repository draft, not an accepted or submitted research paper.
